english.title: Premises owner or occupier cause water fitting to be such that water contamination likely by return from mains
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner or occupier of premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) to which a supply of water was provided by a water

(A)_[undertaker,]_
(B)_[supply licensee,]_

intentionally or negligently caused or suffered a water fitting, namely **(..SPECIFY WATER FITTING..), for which you were responsible to be or remain so out of order, so in need of repair or so constructed or adapted, or to be so used that water in a

(C)_[water]_
(D)_[pipe connected with a water]_

main or other pipe of a water undertaker was or was likely to be contaminated by the return of a substance from those premises to that main or pipe
english.legislation: Contrary to section 73(1)(a) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the owner or occupier of premises

intentionally or negligently caused or suffered a water fitting for which you were responsible
